packageRules.description: fedora base image major bumps are IGNORED (not even proposed): the fedora:46/rawhide image's dnf repos serve fc45-built packages with a keyring mismatch, breaking container builds (same upstream defect as tuna-os/tacklebox#205, tuna-os/bluefin-cli#167). automerge:false alone did not stop renovate elsewhere; ignore prevents PR creation entirely. Remove this rule once the upstream image is consistent.

serde >=1.0.227 removed the `__private` module that transitive dep swc_common 9.2.0 imports (E0432 unresolved import), breaking the build. Pinned to the Cargo.toml working version; re-enable once swc_common is bumped.
